translation: I think that when the eye grows a nebula (翳膜), it is the shaoyang channel wrapping around from behind the eye and causing blindness. If one frequently rubs the four canthi and the space between the brows and the root of the nose, the channels and collaterals become active, and the nebula naturally recedes. Those with disease of the eye, why not try it? I once met a young blind person, both eyes covered with white nebula; I told him to rub the four canthi, and after one day it changed to being full of red threads, with tears flowing as if weeping; unfortunately he was unwilling and stopped. The momentum has no middle ground; how do I know it could not recede completely and become bright again? A newly grown nebula recedes when rubbed; I have already tried it repeatedly and it has been effective every time.
